subject: Cannot connect to shiny server on AWS

messages.author: f7825395596c3639
messages.subject: Cannot connect to shiny server on AWS
parts:
Hi,  I have installed shiny server on AWS.  When I start it, it says running on port 3838.  However, when I try to connect to it,  http://<aws-instance-name>:3838 , it does not connect and times out after a couple of minutes. 

[2013-05-21 23:23:43.943] [INFO] shiny-server - Shiny Server v0.3.5 (Node.js v0.8.19)
[2013-05-21 23:23:43.946] [INFO] shiny-server - Using config file "/etc/shiny-server/shiny-server.conf"
[2013-05-21 23:23:43.970] [INFO] shiny-server - Starting listener on 0.0.0.0:3838

messages.author: 0ad19fd0834527c1
messages.subject: Re: Cannot connect to shiny server on AWS
parts:

messages.author: 0ad19fd0834527c1
messages.subject: Re: Cannot connect to shiny server on AWS
parts:
When you log into the AWS console and go to EC2 there should be a button on the left called Security Groups. Once you're there you can view all the Security Groups you've created (by default there's only one, called 'default'). Click on that, then go to Inbound on the window that appears, then add 3838 as the port range and click Add Rule, then Apply Rule Changes.

The page should look like this before you add it: http://imgur.com/zWSMQNl

Hope that works!
